Yes. Cloudflare's Agents SDK packages now support AI SDK v7 as well as v6. Per the agents, @cloudflare/ai-chat, @cloudflare/codemode, and @cloudflare/think packages changelog entry from July 23, 2026.

- **Upgrading is optional.** Teams can stay on v6 when they update these packages, and applications can also adopt v7 without changing the Cloudflare Agents APIs they use.
- **Version pairing.** The supported peer ranges are ai@^6 || ^7 and @ai-sdk/react@^3 || ^4. Major versions must match: v6 goes with @ai-sdk/react v3, and v7 goes with @ai-sdk/react v4.
- **Install command for v7.** The changelog gives a command that installs the latest Agents packages along with ai@^7 @ai-sdk/react@^4, with equivalents for yarn, pnpm, and bun.
- **Think.** According to a community mirror of the changelog, Think normalizes streaming, tool completion events, and telemetry across both AI SDK versions. Existing v6 applications do not need to migrate these integrations before updating Think.

Related caveat: Cloudflare's AI Search docs say that the latest version 4 [of workers-ai-provider] requires AI SDK v7, but ai-search-provider requires v6, so npm fails to install them together. In that case, pin workers-ai-provider to v3. The AI Search changelog also notes that the ai-search-provider package targets AI SDK v6 (ai@^6).

Sources: the official Cloudflare changelog entry is the primary source. The community forum post and MWPro blog repeat it.

content.text:
Yes. Since July 23, 2026, Cloudflare's `agents`, `@cloudflare/ai-chat`, `@cloudflare/codemode` and `@cloudflare/think` packages support both AI SDK v6 and v7. The peer ranges are `ai@^6 || ^7` and `@ai-sdk/react@^3 || ^4`. The major versions have to match: `ai` v7 goes with `@ai-sdk/react` v4. You don't have to upgrade to v7, and the Agents APIs are the same on either version. One catch: `workers-ai-provider` v4 requires AI SDK v7, but `ai-search-provider` still requires v6. If you need both, pin `workers-ai-provider` to v3 or npm won't install them together.

Sources:
- [Agents SDK packages support AI SDK v6 and v7 (Cloudflare changelog)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-07-23-ai-sdk-v6-v7-support/)
